description: Alluvium OEE Gauge is a free Power BI custom visual for manufacturing and operations teams who track Overall Equipment Effectiveness. Bind three measures — Availability, Performance, and Quality — and the visual calculates OEE (A × P × Q). Optional Target drives color bands (on target / near target / below). Optional Category supports line, machine, or shift views. Built for mid-market plants that need a clear OEE readout on the same trusted model as finance and ops — not another spreadsheet. Features: • Main OEE gauge plus Availability, Performance, and Quality component gauges • Target tick on the OEE arc (target also in tooltips) • Format pane: colors, thresholds, decimals, arc thickness, font sizes • Accepts 0–1 or 0–100 style inputs • No network calls from the visual Publisher: Alluvium LLC Support: https://www.alluviumbi.com/contact Privacy: https://www.alluviumbi.com/privacy
